mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES keeps rising from the current level, weekday foot traffic expands first and then spills into shopping and dining trips, pushing RETAIL_REC above its last-four-week mean over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its prior 4-week mean within 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying flat or increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A continued elevation in RESIDENTIAL and muted PARKS mobility indicates more time spent near home, which suppresses discretionary mall and dining trips and lowers RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated and PARKS stays below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in TRANSIT from one week to the next is a proxy for tightened access or reduced commuting, and that shock cuts retail visitation with the strongest effect in the next four weeks.
failure_condition: After a week-on-week TRANSIT drop exceeding 10 points, RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior 4-week mean over the following 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both strengthen at the same time, commuting density and daytime exposure rise together, producing a short-lag increase in RETAIL_REC within the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase within 7 days when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise together versus their prior-week levels.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS after a prior dip signals better outdoor conditions and broader leisure mobility, which then lifts retail and restaurant activity over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises from below -5 to above -3
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after PARKS crosses from below -5 to above -3.

mechanism_narrative: High GROCERY_PHARM together with a stable or rising RESIDENTIAL share implies precautionary household stocking and reduced discretionary outings, which suppresses retail recreation over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above 45 while RESIDENTIAL stays above 3
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above 45 and RESIDENTIAL remaining above 3.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES loses momentum while TRANSIT remains only slightly above baseline, the commute-retail channel weakens and RETAIL_REC drifts lower over the next month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its prior 4-week mean within 28 days after two consecutive weekly declines in WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: With WORKPLACES trending up and TRANSIT already positive, the market is still rebuilding daytime circulation; that pattern should keep retail-recreation mobility edging upward over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is lower over the next 14 days than over the last 14 days while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain above baseline.
